summary.heading: Summary
summary.intro: Your money for the period: totals, spend by category against your budget, and the recent trend.
summary.sign_in_prompt: Sign in to see your summary.
summary.empty: Nothing to show for this period yet.
summary.trend_aria: Line chart of the net amount over the last six periods, oldest to newest.

explore.heading: Explore
explore.intro: Filter your transactions and view them grouped by month, week, category, or account — as a line or bar chart, a pie, or a table. The filters live in the URL, so any view is shareable.
explore.sign_in_prompt: Sign in to explore your transactions.
explore.cap_note: Showing the 1000 most recent matching transactions.
explore.pie_excluded: {n} group(s) with a non-positive value are hidden from the pie.
explore.view_empty: No saved views yet — save the current view above.
explore.view_delete_confirm: Delete the saved view {name}? Widgets that copied it keep working.

dashboards.heading: Dashboards
dashboards.intro: Create dashboards, fill them with saved Explore views and markdown notes, and resize or reorder the widgets.
dashboards.sign_in: Sign in to see your dashboards.
dashboards.empty: No dashboards yet — create one below.
dashboards.delete_confirm: Delete the dashboard {name} and all of its widgets?
dashboards.not_found: This dashboard does not exist — it may have been deleted.
dashboards.no_widgets: No widgets yet — add your first one below.
dashboards.handle_width: Drag to change the widget's width
dashboards.handle_height: Drag to change the widget's height
dashboards.handle_corner: Drag to change the widget's width and height
dashboards.widget_savings_account_required: Pick an account for the appreciation view.

budgets.heading: Budgets
budgets.intro: Set per-category targets and track your spending against them for the current period and the last six windows.
budgets.sign_in_prompt: Sign in to manage your budgets.
budgets.empty: No budgets yet — create one below to start tracking.
budgets.period_fixed: The period is fixed at creation and cannot be changed.

mortgage.heading: Mortgage
mortgage.sign_in_prompt: Sign in to manage your mortgage.
mortgage.add_note: Record the loan terms and the engine amortises it for you.
mortgage.chart_aria: Line chart of the remaining balance and the growing equity across the amortization schedule
mortgage.table_hint: Click a year to expand its payments.
mortgage.events_hint: A rate change re-runs the amortization from its effective date.
mortgage.match_hint: Debits on the linked account matched against the schedule. Read-only: nothing is changed automatically.
mortgage.match_flag_no_transactions: No debit transactions were found on the linked account.
mortgage.match_flag_payment_below_minimum_payoff: A run of payments is below the minimum needed to pay off within the remaining term.
mortgage.match_flag_payment_above_maximum_rate: A run of payments implies a rate above 100%.
mortgage.match_suggestions_empty: No sustained deviation suggests a rate change.
mortgage.classify_intro: These payments do not fit your schedule. Say what each one was — the answers keep the balance and payoff math accurate.
mortgage.classify_one_off_hint: A one-off: the amount went to principal, so your rate and payment are unchanged.
mortgage.classify_rate_hint: A rate change: from this date your payment re-amortizes at the new rate.

savings.heading: Savings
savings.intro: Registered-plan room for the selected year: annual limits, contributions, room left, and lifetime caps for RESP and RDSP.
savings.sign_in_prompt: Sign in to see your savings room.
savings.non_cad_note: Some plan accounts are denominated in {cur}. Amounts stay in each account's own currency and are not converted.
savings.plan_accounts_hint: Select an account to track its appreciation.
savings.no_plan_accounts: No registered-plan accounts yet — add one in Settings → Accounts.
savings.birth_banner: Add your birth year to enable the age-based rules (TFSA minimum age, RRSP age 71, RRIF minimum withdrawal).
savings.rrif_minimum_hint: Calculated from the January 1 balance snapshot and your age.
savings.warning_limit_unknown: The annual limit for this year is unknown — no statutory figure applies and no override is set.
savings.warning_over_limit: Room is negative: contributions exceed this year's limit.
savings.warning_tfsa_min_age: You were under 18 in this year — TFSA contributions require age 18+.
savings.warning_rrsp_age_71: You turn 71 this year — RRSP contributions are allowed until Dec 31 of this year.
savings.warning_fhsa_pre_launch: This FHSA account opened before the plan's 2023-04-01 launch — check the account data.
savings.warning_lifetime_over_limit: Lifetime room is negative: lifetime contributions exceed the cap.
savings.warning_resp_age_31: The beneficiary turns 31 in this year — RESP contributions must stop.
savings.warning_rdsp_age_59: The beneficiary turns 59 in this year — RDSP contributions must stop.
savings.warning_rrif_age_unknown: Your birth year is unknown, so the RRIF minimum withdrawal cannot be calculated.
savings.warning_rrif_no_fmv: No balance snapshot on or before Jan 1 of this year, so the RRIF minimum withdrawal cannot be calculated.
savings.note_rrsp_actual_limit: The statutory figure is the cap, not your personal limit — set an override with your actual limit.
savings.note_rrsp_recontribution: RRSP withdrawals may be re-contributed within 36 months without using room.
savings.note_fhsa_window: The 15-year FHSA window has closed — the account must be closed and funds withdrawn.
savings.note_resp_cesg_stops: CESG is no longer eligible (beneficiary age 17+).
savings.note_rdsp_cds_stops: CDSG is no longer eligible (beneficiary age 49+).
savings.note_rrif_year_opened: This RRIF was opened in the selected year, so it has no minimum withdrawal for that year.
savings.note_rrif_conversion_due: You turn 71 in this year — the RRSP must be converted to a RRIF by Dec 31 of the year you turn 71.
savings.override_hint: Overrides this plan's annual limit for the selected year only.
savings.override_format_error: Enter a non-negative number with up to 2 decimals.
savings.adjustments_hint: Manually correct this plan's room for the selected year, e.g. for a contribution the app could not see. A negative amount reduces room.
savings.adjustment_format_error: Enter a number with up to 2 decimals.
savings.detail_sign_in: Sign in to view this account.
savings.appreciation_not_found: Account not found — it may have been deleted.
savings.appreciation_hint: Snapshot balances with the running balance between them (last snapshot plus counted transactions).
savings.appreciation_chart_empty: No balance snapshots yet — add one below to start the series.
savings.snapshot_date_invalid: The date must be today or earlier.
savings.snapshot_balance_invalid: Enter a balance of 0.00 or more.
savings.recent_tx_empty: No transactions on this account yet.

auth.callback_failed: Sign-in could not be completed. Please go home and try again.
auth.session_expired_body: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.

onboarding.title: Onboarding
onboarding.categories_note: Unchecked categories are not created. You can add, edit, or delete categories any time in settings.

imports.title: Imports
imports.intro: Upload a bank statement (CSV, JSON, or OFX/QFX), map its columns to the app's fields, and preview the result before the import runs.
imports.no_accounts: No accounts yet — add one in settings.
imports.drop_hint: Drag and drop a statement file here, or
imports.mapping_csv_note: Pick the column for each field; leave a field unmapped if the file has no equivalent.
imports.mapping_json_note: Type the JSON pointer to each field (RFC 6901, e.g. /amount).
imports.array_pointers_note: Comma-separated pointers to the array holding the transactions, tried in order. (root) = the document root; leave blank for root only.
imports.ofx_note: OFX/QFX files map their fields automatically — there is nothing to map. Confirm to store the mapping.
imports.preview_empty: Map at least one field to see a preview.
imports.save_preset_hint: Save this mapping as a reusable preset for this account's statements.

manual_entry.title: Add a transaction manually
manual_entry.intro: Record a transaction that isn't in any statement — it enters the same pipeline as an import.
manual_entry.no_accounts: No accounts yet — add one in settings.
manual_entry.amount_note: Plain number, up to two decimal places; a minus sign for debits. No currency symbols or thousands separators.
manual_entry.missing: An account, a posted date, and an amount are required.
manual_entry.transfer_same_account: The transfer source and destination must be different accounts.
manual_entry.external_origin_note: Government grants and inheritances never count toward registered-plan limits.

review.title: Review queue
review.intro: Transactions the auto-categoriser wasn't confident about. Pick a category to resolve a row, or ask the model to try the row again.
review.sign_in_prompt: Sign in to review your transactions.
review.empty: Nothing to review — the queue is empty.
review.not_applied: Below the confidence threshold — the row stays in the queue.
review.edit_not_found: The transaction is no longer available.

offsets.title: Offsets
offsets.intro: Money that simply moved between your own accounts (like paying a credit card from chequing) should not count as spend in one and income in the other. The scan finds pairs that net out to zero; accepting one removes both legs from the transaction lists and the aggregates.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Alerts from the app — open one to act on it right here; alerts clear themselves once their item is resolved.
notifications.sign_in_prompt: Sign in to see your notifications.
notifications.suggestion_gone: This suggestion is no longer in the mortgage's matching report.
notifications.item_gone: This item is no longer in the mortgage's matching report.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: App settings: appearance and default currency, the LLM endpoint the auto-categoriser talks to, per provider, and the categories used to classify transactions.
settings.mail_disabled: Email notifications are disabled on this server — no email is sent for account events.
settings.sign_in_prompt: Sign in to manage your settings.
settings.api_key_optional_note: Optional — self-hosted servers usually need no key.
settings.mask_note: The field shows the stored key's mask; the key itself is encrypted and never read back. Re-enter the key to keep it on the next save.
settings.test_ok: Connected in {ms} ms — {tin} tokens in / {tout} tokens out.
settings.categories_note: The vocabulary for classifying transactions. Checked categories are offered when you add or review a transaction; unchecked ones stay on existing transactions but are hidden from the pickers. Deleting a category keeps its transactions — they become uncategorized.
settings.cat_delete_confirm: Delete category “{name}”? Its transactions are kept (uncategorized).
settings.accounts_note: The accounts your transactions, imports, and mortgages point at. Renaming or re-typing one keeps its history; deleting it removes its transactions, import jobs, and mortgages.
settings.acct_delete_confirm: Delete account “{name}”? Its transactions, import jobs, and mortgages are removed too.
settings.acct_balance_invalid: Enter a balance of 0.00 or more.
settings.acct_opened_invalid: The date must be today or earlier.
